scope: Fixed16 TRAIN batches, M95 eval forward, 33 recoverable failures. Phrase groups are the dataset's own token maps: positive_map (referent mention), modify (attributes), pron (pronouns), other_entity (other mentioned objects), rel (relations). Three scoring variants per group: qproj = trained vision/text projection cosine (the sem_align operator, exactly in distribution on the query side); pointregion = trained sampling language-point matcher pooled over the query's predicted mask; raw = unprojected feature cosine to the group centroid. Diagnostic only; no model, novelty or efficacy admission.
